wild.oewn-02398903-a.label: negative

family.axis: control merely absent → excitement past the reach of reason

wild.oewn-02398903-a.tone: Names the extremity of the missing restraint without colouring it, and tips negative only because the gloss calls the lack extreme rather than partial.

wild.oewn-02397788-a.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly untamed → untamed and threatening

wild.oewn-02397788-a.tone: Neutral and broad - it covers the animal, the plant and the uncultivated ground alike, naming the natural state without passing any verdict on it.

chaotic.oewn-02399137-s.label: negative

family.axis: control merely absent → excitement past the reach of reason

chaotic.oewn-02399137-s.tone: Faults the state for what it does to anyone trying to follow it — unordered, unpredictable and confusing at once, where *wild* only says the reins are off.

disorderly.oewn-02399137-s.label: negative

family.axis: control merely absent → excitement past the reach of reason

disorderly.oewn-02399137-s.tone: Carries the same absence of order as *chaotic* but frames it as an order failed rather than an order never present.

delirious.oewn-02399292-s.label: negative

family.axis: control merely absent → excitement past the reach of reason

delirious.oewn-02399292-s.tone: Pitches the uncontrolled feeling high enough to suggest the senses have gone with it, which *excited* never implies.

excited.oewn-02399292-s.label: neutral

family.axis: control merely absent → excitement past the reach of reason

excited.oewn-02399292-s.tone: The unloaded member: it records the uncontrolled excitement and leaves the verdict to whoever is listening.

frantic.oewn-02399292-s.label: negative

family.axis: control merely absent → excitement past the reach of reason

frantic.oewn-02399292-s.tone: Adds hurry and distress to the same uncontrolled feeling, so the energy reads as flailing rather than pleasure.

mad.oewn-02399292-s.label: negative

family.axis: control merely absent → excitement past the reach of reason

mad.oewn-02399292-s.tone: Blunt and dismissive — it calls the uncontrolled emotion unreason outright instead of merely hinting at it as *delirious* does.

unrestrained.oewn-02399292-s.label: negative

family.axis: control merely absent → excitement past the reach of reason

unrestrained.oewn-02399292-s.tone: The coolest word here, naming the control that is missing rather than picturing the emotion that fills the gap.

frenzied.oewn-02399571-s.label: negative

family.axis: control merely absent → excitement past the reach of reason

frenzied.oewn-02399571-s.tone: Reason is overrun rather than loosened, and the word fits both the person seized by the frenzy and the scene that shows it.

manic.oewn-02399571-s.label: negative

family.axis: control merely absent → excitement past the reach of reason

manic.oewn-02399571-s.tone: Gives the same reasonless frenzy a clinical ring, where *frenzied* stays pure motion.

unsubdued.oewn-02399910-s.label: neutral

family.axis: control merely absent → excitement past the reach of reason

unsubdued.oewn-02399910-s.tone: A flat negative that says only that control was never imposed, so it can read as endurance as easily as excess.

indecent.oewn-00686462-a.label: negative

family.axis: impropriety merely hinted at → indecency flagrant enough to provoke

indecent.oewn-00686462-a.tone: The family's flat verdict of offence to good taste, sexual matters foremost though not only those, condemning without the flagrancy *crude* insists on.

crude.oewn-00686808-s.label: negative

family.axis: impropriety merely hinted at → indecency flagrant enough to provoke

crude.oewn-00686808-s.tone: Blunt and graceless force: the indecency is out in the open with no refinement over it, where *indecent* only names the offence.

earthy.oewn-00686808-s.label: negative

family.axis: impropriety merely hinted at → indecency flagrant enough to provoke

earthy.oewn-00686808-s.tone: The mildest-sounding word for the same conspicuous, tasteless indecency, its plainness softening what *gross* spits out.

gross.oewn-00686808-s.label: negative

family.axis: impropriety merely hinted at → indecency flagrant enough to provoke

gross.oewn-00686808-s.tone: Registers revulsion rather than disapproval, the indecency coarse enough to sicken, and the word is the flinch.

vulgar.oewn-00686808-s.label: negative

family.axis: impropriety merely hinted at → indecency flagrant enough to provoke

vulgar.oewn-00686808-s.tone: Passes judgement on the sensibility behind the indecency as much as on the act, a verdict of cheapness that *earthy* declines to pass.

indelicate.oewn-00687331-s.label: negative

family.axis: impropriety merely hinted at → indecency flagrant enough to provoke

indelicate.oewn-00687331-s.tone: The lightest reproof here, indecency approached but not arrived at, so it rebukes where *obscene* accuses.

obscene.oewn-00687440-s.label: negative

family.axis: impropriety merely hinted at → indecency flagrant enough to provoke

obscene.oewn-00687440-s.tone: The heaviest charge in the family: not merely offensive but built to incite indecency or lust, design rather than effect.

suggestive.oewn-00687611-s.label: negative

family.axis: impropriety merely hinted at → indecency flagrant enough to provoke

suggestive.oewn-00687611-s.tone: Works by implication, pointing toward the improper or the indecent without stating it, and accuses more lightly than *crude* for that reason.

intolerable.oewn-02444489-a.label: negative

family.axis: hard to bear → past all bearing or defending

intolerable.oewn-02444489-a.tone: The flat verdict of the three - it rules the thing out rather than measuring what holding it costs, which is what *unbearable* does.

unbearable.oewn-02444489-a.label: negative

family.axis: hard to bear → past all bearing or defending

unbearable.oewn-02444489-a.tone: Puts the weight on whoever is carrying it, so the limit reached is a person's capacity rather than the judgement *intolerable* hands down.

unendurable.oewn-02444489-a.label: negative

family.axis: hard to bear → past all bearing or defending

unendurable.oewn-02444489-a.tone: The same limit measured in duration - what cannot be lasted out, where *unbearable* is what cannot be held up under.

bitter.oewn-02444782-s.label: negative

family.axis: hard to bear → past all bearing or defending

bitter.oewn-02444782-s.tone: The one member that concedes the thing can be accepted or borne, at a price the others say is past paying at all.

insufferable.oewn-02444906-s.label: negative

family.axis: hard to bear → past all bearing or defending

insufferable.oewn-02444906-s.tone: Names the excess itself - the thing has gone past a limit, where *intolerable* simply refuses it without saying by how much.

unsufferable.oewn-02444906-s.label: negative

family.axis: hard to bear → past all bearing or defending

unsufferable.oewn-02444906-s.tone: Says exactly what *insufferable* says, and the difference is flatness rather than degree.

impossible.oewn-02445119-s.label: negative

family.axis: hard to bear → past all bearing or defending

impossible.oewn-02445119-s.tone: Exasperated rather than judicial - it writes a person or their conduct off as beyond dealing with, where *unacceptable* files a ruling.

unacceptable.oewn-02445119-s.label: negative

family.axis: hard to bear → past all bearing or defending

unacceptable.oewn-02445119-s.tone: The cool, formal counterpart of *impossible*: it finds the person or the behaviour unreasonable without any of the heat.

unsupportable.oewn-02445449-s.label: negative

family.axis: hard to bear → past all bearing or defending

unsupportable.oewn-02445449-s.tone: Shifts the fault from what cannot be borne to what cannot be defended, so the weakness is in the thing's own standing rather than in anyone's strain.

perfect.oewn-01753804-a.label: positive

family.axis: no fault found in it → complete and consummate perfection

perfect.oewn-01753804-a.tone: The unqualified standard here, claiming completeness of its kind as well as the absence of blemish, where *flawless* claims only the absence.

clean.oewn-01754399-s.label: positive

family.axis: no fault found in it → complete and consummate perfection

clean.oewn-01754399-s.tone: Praise by absence - a record with nothing marked against it, a narrower claim than the completeness *perfect* asserts.

clear.oewn-01754557-s.label: positive

family.axis: no fault found in it → complete and consummate perfection

clear.oewn-01754557-s.tone: Reaches past flaw and blemish to impurity as well, so it can clear a substance and not only a performance.

cold.oewn-01754740-s.label: positive

family.axis: no fault found in it → complete and consummate perfection

cold.oewn-01754740-s.tone: Perfection as drilled familiarity - the thing is known so thoroughly that error does not arise, where *errorless* only reports that none did.

cold.oewn-01073210-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely past its freshness → rotted, foul and crawling

cold.oewn-01073210-s.tone: Understated to the edge of euphemism - it says only that time has passed and the freshness with it, leaving the conclusion *stale* states outright unsaid.

complete.oewn-01754870-s.label: positive

family.axis: no fault found in it → complete and consummate perfection

complete.oewn-01754870-s.tone: Asserts that every necessary quality is present, the opposite test from *flawless*: nothing missing rather than nothing wrong.

consummate.oewn-01754870-s.label: positive

family.axis: no fault found in it → complete and consummate perfection

consummate.oewn-01754870-s.tone: Formal and superlative where *complete* is plain, pitching the same total sufficiency as an accolade.

down.oewn-01755101-s.label: positive

family.axis: no fault found in it → complete and consummate perfection

down.oewn-01755101-s.tone: Puts the perfection in the grasp rather than in the thing - the understanding is finished, and it says so flatly.

down_pat.oewn-01755101-s.label: positive

family.axis: no fault found in it → complete and consummate perfection

down_pat.oewn-01755101-s.tone: The idiom tightens *down* into exactness: not merely understood but understood to the letter.

mastered.oewn-01755101-s.label: positive

family.axis: no fault found in it → complete and consummate perfection

mastered.oewn-01755101-s.tone: Dignifies the same perfect understanding as an attainment, where *down* merely reports the state.

errorless.oewn-01755230-s.label: positive

family.axis: no fault found in it → complete and consummate perfection

errorless.oewn-01755230-s.tone: A flat count of no errors, the coolest word in the family beside *impeccable*'s admiration.

faultless.oewn-01755331-s.label: positive

family.axis: no fault found in it → complete and consummate perfection

faultless.oewn-01755331-s.tone: Takes in fault as well as error, so it acquits the conduct and not just the execution.

immaculate.oewn-01755331-s.label: positive

family.axis: no fault found in it → complete and consummate perfection

immaculate.oewn-01755331-s.tone: Lifts the same absence of fault into something untouched, admiring where *errorless* is merely accurate.

impeccable.oewn-01755331-s.label: positive

family.axis: no fault found in it → complete and consummate perfection

impeccable.oewn-01755331-s.tone: Reads the absence of fault as a standard held to - admiration rather than measurement.

incorrupted.oewn-01755331-s.label: positive

family.axis: no fault found in it → complete and consummate perfection

incorrupted.oewn-01755331-s.tone: Frames faultlessness as something kept intact rather than achieved, and in a stiffer register than *faultless*.

flawless.oewn-01755578-s.label: positive

family.axis: no fault found in it → complete and consummate perfection

flawless.oewn-01755578-s.tone: Single-minded - one flaw would undo it, where *complete* asks instead whether everything is there.

unflawed.oewn-01755578-s.label: positive

family.axis: no fault found in it → complete and consummate perfection

unflawed.oewn-01755578-s.tone: The plain negation beside *flawless*, denying the flaw without carrying the admiration.

hard.oewn-01158857-a.label: negative

family.axis: unmoved by feeling → coldly working to a purpose

hard.oewn-01158857-a.tone: Chilly rather than cruel - feeling is simply switched off, and nothing is said about what the coolness is for.

hard.oewn-01073471-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely past its freshness → rotted, foul and crawling

hard.oewn-01073471-s.tone: Reports a texture rather than a decay — the food has dried out, not gone foul — which makes it the least damning word in the family.

calculating.oewn-01159105-s.label: negative

family.axis: unmoved by feeling → coldly working to a purpose

calculating.oewn-01159105-s.tone: Purpose read as cold arithmetic - the aim is granted, the warmth withdrawn.

calculative.oewn-01159105-s.label: negative

family.axis: unmoved by feeling → coldly working to a purpose

calculative.oewn-01159105-s.tone: The flatter, drier twin of *calculating*, closer to bare goal-directedness and lighter on the accusation.

conniving.oewn-01159105-s.label: negative

family.axis: unmoved by feeling → coldly working to a purpose

conniving.oewn-01159105-s.tone: The darkest reading of the same goal-directedness - purpose taken as plotting rather than planning.

scheming.oewn-01159105-s.label: negative

family.axis: unmoved by feeling → coldly working to a purpose

scheming.oewn-01159105-s.tone: Condemns the same purposefulness as *calculating*, but puts the weight on the plan rather than on the coldness of the planner.

shrewd.oewn-01159105-s.label: positive

family.axis: unmoved by feeling → coldly working to a purpose

shrewd.oewn-01159105-s.tone: The one word here that credits the goal-directedness, treating aim and judgement as sharpness rather than as a fault.

case-hardened.oewn-01159329-s.label: negative

family.axis: unmoved by feeling → coldly working to a purpose

case-hardened.oewn-01159329-s.tone: The most final of the hardened set - the toughness reads as settled all the way through, with nothing soft left to reach.

hardened.oewn-01159329-s.label: negative

family.axis: unmoved by feeling → coldly working to a purpose

hardened.oewn-01159329-s.tone: The plain statement of the condition, naming the lost feeling without *hard-boiled*'s relish or *case-hardened*'s finality.

hard-boiled.oewn-01159329-s.label: negative

family.axis: unmoved by feeling → coldly working to a purpose

hard-boiled.oewn-01159329-s.tone: Informal, and the toughness comes with a swagger - the unfeeling is worn rather than lamented.

steely.oewn-01159482-s.label: neutral

family.axis: unmoved by feeling → coldly working to a purpose

steely.oewn-01159482-s.tone: Not a verdict but a likeness - it measures hardness against metal and leaves the reader to decide whether that is a fault.

comfortable.oewn-00478809-a.label: positive

family.axis: plain physical ease → warm, enveloping comfort

comfortable.oewn-00478809-a.tone: The plain baseline of the set, covering both the chair and the person sitting in it, without the warmth *cozy* adds.

comfy.oewn-00478809-a.label: positive

family.axis: plain physical ease → warm, enveloping comfort

comfy.oewn-00478809-a.tone: Informal and fond where *comfortable* is plain, claiming no more ease than it does — only a softer way of saying it.

cozy.oewn-00479274-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain physical ease → warm, enveloping comfort

cozy.oewn-00479274-s.tone: Adds warmth and shelter to *comfortable*'s bare ease, the comfort of being enclosed and kept warm.

cosy.oewn-00479274-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain physical ease → warm, enveloping comfort

cosy.oewn-00479274-s.tone: Carries exactly *cozy*'s sheltered warmth; the difference is one of spelling, not of force.

snug.oewn-00479274-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain physical ease → warm, enveloping comfort

snug.oewn-00479274-s.tone: Puts the weight on close fit — comfort from being tucked into a small space rather than merely warmed, more bodily than *cozy*.

easy.oewn-00479543-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain physical ease → warm, enveloping comfort

easy.oewn-00479543-s.tone: The thinnest word here: it says a thing affords comfort and stops, with none of *cozy*'s warmth or *soothing*'s relief.

homelike.oewn-00479651-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain physical ease → warm, enveloping comfort

homelike.oewn-00479651-s.tone: Locates the comfort in the feeling of home, so it praises a place for putting you at ease rather than for warmth alone as *cozy* does.

homely.oewn-00479651-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain physical ease → warm, enveloping comfort

homely.oewn-00479651-s.tone: The same home-feeling approval as *homelike*, settled and unshowy — the praise is for the ease of the place, not its grandeur.

homey.oewn-00479651-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain physical ease → warm, enveloping comfort

homey.oewn-00479651-s.tone: Informal where *homelike* is plainly descriptive, saying the same home-comfort more casually.

homy.oewn-00479651-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain physical ease → warm, enveloping comfort

homy.oewn-00479651-s.tone: A spelling variant of *homey*, identical in its fond, informal warmth toward a place that feels like home.

soothing.oewn-00479886-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain physical ease → warm, enveloping comfort

soothing.oewn-00479886-s.tone: Comfort framed as active relief — where *easy* merely affords comfort, this one implies a physical discomfort being eased.

displeased.oewn-01811138-a.label: neutral

family.axis: cool displeasure → provoked past patience into revulsion

displeased.oewn-01811138-a.tone: The family's coolest term: it registers the absence of pleasure and lets it show, without conceding any heat to it.

annoyed.oewn-01811355-s.label: negative

family.axis: cool displeasure → provoked past patience into revulsion

annoyed.oewn-01811355-s.tone: The plain, unheated name for the state: impatience or anger without the colouring that *miffed* or *steamed* add to it.

irritated.oewn-01811355-s.label: negative

family.axis: cool displeasure → provoked past patience into revulsion

irritated.oewn-01811355-s.tone: Friction rather than flare: the same impatience or anger, but felt as something rubbing on and on rather than landing once like *stung*.

miffed.oewn-01811355-s.label: negative

family.axis: cool displeasure → provoked past patience into revulsion

miffed.oewn-01811355-s.tone: Light and slightly diminishing, it sizes the impatience or anger as a small thing and the person holding it as easily put out, where *annoyed* passes no such judgement.

nettled.oewn-01811355-s.label: negative

family.axis: cool displeasure → provoked past patience into revulsion

nettled.oewn-01811355-s.tone: Prickled and smarting: the state as something that caught and stings still, sharper in point than *annoyed* and briefer than *irritated*.

peeved.oewn-01811355-s.label: negative

family.axis: cool displeasure → provoked past patience into revulsion

peeved.oewn-01811355-s.tone: Small and faintly comic, it scales the impatience or anger down to a grievance worth mentioning but not worth raising your voice over.

pissed.oewn-01811355-s.label: negative

family.axis: cool displeasure → provoked past patience into revulsion

pissed.oewn-01811355-s.tone: Vulgar and blunt, it states the same impatience or anger in the coarsest register the family has, which is everything *displeased* withholds.

pissed_off.oewn-01811355-s.label: negative

family.axis: cool displeasure → provoked past patience into revulsion

pissed_off.oewn-01811355-s.tone: Carries the coarse charge of *pissed* with the particle adding follow-through, anger sent outward rather than merely held.

riled.oewn-01811355-s.label: negative

family.axis: cool displeasure → provoked past patience into revulsion

riled.oewn-01811355-s.tone: Stirred up rather than simply arrived at: it puts the impatience or anger down to having been worked into someone.

roiled.oewn-01811355-s.label: negative

family.axis: cool displeasure → provoked past patience into revulsion

roiled.oewn-01811355-s.tone: Churn instead of flare, the impatience or anger turbid and unsettled all through, where *stung* is one sharp point.

steamed.oewn-01811355-s.label: negative

family.axis: cool displeasure → provoked past patience into revulsion

steamed.oewn-01811355-s.tone: Pressure made visible, the heat contained but plainly building, hotter than *peeved* and short of the coarseness of *pissed off*.

stung.oewn-01811355-s.label: negative

family.axis: cool displeasure → provoked past patience into revulsion

stung.oewn-01811355-s.tone: The state as recoil: something landed, and the impatience or anger is the flinch back from it, where *irritated* only wears on.

exasperated.oewn-01811732-s.label: negative

family.axis: cool displeasure → provoked past patience into revulsion

exasperated.oewn-01811732-s.tone: The end of the line, annoyance carried far enough that patience is spent, which is exactly what *annoyed* still holds in reserve.

cheesed_off.oewn-01811732-s.label: negative

family.axis: cool displeasure → provoked past patience into revulsion

cheesed_off.oewn-01811732-s.tone: British and deflating: a full loss of patience carried in a phrase too offhand to shout, where *exasperated* keeps its composure.

browned_off.oewn-01811732-s.label: negative

family.axis: cool displeasure → provoked past patience into revulsion

browned_off.oewn-01811732-s.tone: Flat, worn British informality, the patience gone by erosion rather than blown out like *steamed*.

disgusted.oewn-01811926-s.label: negative

family.axis: cool displeasure → provoked past patience into revulsion

disgusted.oewn-01811926-s.tone: Strong distaste from having had too much of a thing, the surfeited turn of the stomach rather than heat aimed at anyone, and the family's furthest recoil.

glorious.oewn-01124687-a.label: positive

family.axis: visible brilliance → excellence exalted past the human

glorious.oewn-01124687-a.tone: The family's full measure - glory had, glory deserved and glory handed on, where *illustrious* claims only the having and the conferring.

bright.oewn-01125000-s.label: positive

family.axis: visible brilliance → excellence exalted past the human

bright.oewn-01125000-s.tone: Praise at its plainest - splendid, with none of the awe *sublime* carries or the record standing behind *storied*.

celebrated.oewn-01125164-s.label: positive

family.axis: visible brilliance → excellence exalted past the human

celebrated.oewn-01125164-s.tone: The illustrious past registered as acclaim - others have noticed, which *historied* does not bother to say.

historied.oewn-01125164-s.label: positive

family.axis: visible brilliance → excellence exalted past the human

historied.oewn-01125164-s.tone: The same illustrious past stated as plain fact rather than applause, and more formal for it than *celebrated*.

storied.oewn-01125164-s.label: positive

family.axis: visible brilliance → excellence exalted past the human

storied.oewn-01125164-s.tone: The illustrious past turned into something worth recounting - it implies a tale, where *celebrated* implies only admirers.

divine.oewn-01125269-s.label: positive

family.axis: visible brilliance → excellence exalted past the human

divine.oewn-01125269-s.tone: Excellence pushed past the human scale until it reads as god-given rather than merely achieved.

elysian.oewn-01125269-s.label: positive

family.axis: visible brilliance → excellence exalted past the human

elysian.oewn-01125269-s.tone: The most rarefied way to say that same god-touched excellence - ornate where *divine* is direct.

inspired.oewn-01125269-s.label: positive

family.axis: visible brilliance → excellence exalted past the human

inspired.oewn-01125269-s.tone: The mildest of the three - it credits the surpassing excellence to something breathed in from outside without naming the gods as *divine* and *elysian* do.

empyreal.oewn-01125519-s.label: positive

family.axis: visible brilliance → excellence exalted past the human

empyreal.oewn-01125519-s.tone: Awe pitched at its loftiest and most ornate, where *sublime* delivers the same awe in a word that can be said plainly.

empyrean.oewn-01125519-s.label: positive

family.axis: visible brilliance → excellence exalted past the human

empyrean.oewn-01125519-s.tone: Matched to *empyreal* in force - awe as sheer altitude, something the eye has to be raised to.

sublime.oewn-01125519-s.label: positive

family.axis: visible brilliance → excellence exalted past the human

sublime.oewn-01125519-s.tone: Awe that arrests rather than merely pleases - the word here that admits to being overwhelmed.

illustrious.oewn-01125751-s.label: positive

family.axis: visible brilliance → excellence exalted past the human

illustrious.oewn-01125751-s.tone: Glory as both possession and gift - it holds glory and lends it out, without *glorious*'s further claim that the glory is deserved.

incandescent.oewn-01125883-s.label: positive

family.axis: visible brilliance → excellence exalted past the human

incandescent.oewn-01125883-s.tone: Praise for a white heat, whether of ardent feeling, of intensity or of sheer brilliance - it burns where *lustrous* only shines.

lustrous.oewn-01126031-s.label: positive

family.axis: visible brilliance → excellence exalted past the human

lustrous.oewn-01126031-s.tone: Brilliance as a finish on the surface - it gleams, where *incandescent* burns from inside.

implicit.oewn-00944754-a.label: neutral

family.axis: simply not put into words → lodged in the nature of the thing itself

implicit.oewn-00944754-a.tone: Neutral and two-sided, covering both the meaning that was never spelled out and the one that sits in a thing's nature, where *unspoken* reaches only the first.

inexplicit.oewn-00944754-a.label: negative

family.axis: simply not put into words → lodged in the nature of the thing itself

inexplicit.oewn-00944754-a.tone: Built as a negation, it frames the same implicitness as a shortfall in the telling, where *implicit* frames it as a property of the thing.

implicit_in.oewn-00945209-s.label: neutral

family.axis: simply not put into words → lodged in the nature of the thing itself

implicit_in.oewn-00945209-s.tone: A relational phrase rather than a quality — it must name the thing the sense is lodged in, which the bare adjectives beside it need not do.

inherent.oewn-00945209-s.label: neutral

family.axis: simply not put into words → lodged in the nature of the thing itself

inherent.oewn-00945209-s.tone: The firmest claim of the three: not hidden by accident but built into what the thing is, and so not detachable from it.

underlying.oewn-00945209-s.label: neutral

family.axis: simply not put into words → lodged in the nature of the thing itself

underlying.oewn-00945209-s.tone: Puts the sense beneath a surface rather than inside a nature, implying something could be uncovered, where *inherent* makes it permanent.

silent.oewn-00945432-s.label: neutral

family.axis: simply not put into words → lodged in the nature of the thing itself

silent.oewn-00945432-s.tone: The plain everyday word for a meaning that rides along with an act or a statement without being spoken, lighter in weight than *tacit*.

tacit.oewn-00945432-s.label: neutral

family.axis: simply not put into words → lodged in the nature of the thing itself

tacit.oewn-00945432-s.tone: Formal, and it treats the unspoken meaning as settled and binding — something one is held to, which *silent* does not insist on.

understood.oewn-00945432-s.label: positive

family.axis: simply not put into words → lodged in the nature of the thing itself

understood.oewn-00945432-s.tone: Adds successful uptake: the meaning was not merely implied but taken up on both sides, where *tacit* says only that it went unsaid.

unexpressed.oewn-00945649-s.label: neutral

family.axis: simply not put into words → lodged in the nature of the thing itself

unexpressed.oewn-00945649-s.tone: Neutral and general — it says the thing found no outward form at all, without insisting that words in particular were what went missing.

unsaid.oewn-00945649-s.label: neutral

family.axis: simply not put into words → lodged in the nature of the thing itself

unsaid.oewn-00945649-s.tone: The plainest of the negatives, and it carries a faint sense of something held back, where *unexpressed* is a flat report.

unstated.oewn-00945649-s.label: neutral

family.axis: simply not put into words → lodged in the nature of the thing itself

unstated.oewn-00945649-s.tone: Dry and procedural, marking the absence the way one notes a missing entry, beside the more human *unsaid*.

unuttered.oewn-00945649-s.label: neutral

family.axis: simply not put into words → lodged in the nature of the thing itself

unuttered.oewn-00945649-s.tone: Elevated and faintly literary, shaping the omission as something never let out rather than merely never recorded.

unverbalized.oewn-00945649-s.label: neutral

family.axis: simply not put into words → lodged in the nature of the thing itself

unverbalized.oewn-00945649-s.tone: Clinical in register, framing the gap as a failure to convert into words rather than a silence with any weight to it.

unverbalised.oewn-00945649-s.label: neutral

family.axis: simply not put into words → lodged in the nature of the thing itself

unverbalised.oewn-00945649-s.tone: The British spelling of the same clinical term, identical in force to *unverbalized*.

unvoiced.oewn-00945649-s.label: neutral

family.axis: simply not put into words → lodged in the nature of the thing itself

unvoiced.oewn-00945649-s.tone: Implies a voice was available and went unused, which gives it more pull than the flat *unverbalized*.

unspoken.oewn-00945649-s.label: neutral

family.axis: simply not put into words → lodged in the nature of the thing itself

unspoken.oewn-00945649-s.tone: The most loaded of the plain negatives — what is unspoken feels present and deliberately left alone, where *unstated* is only a blank.

intrusive.oewn-01354915-a.label: negative

family.axis: pushing in where one is unwanted → offensive meddling in what is not one's business

intrusive.oewn-01354915-a.tone: The plain term for the fault: it names the pushing-in itself, without the added charge of trespass that *encroaching* carries or the contempt in *meddlesome*.

encroaching.oewn-01355168-s.label: negative

family.axis: pushing in where one is unwanted → offensive meddling in what is not one's business

encroaching.oewn-01355168-s.tone: Stresses the slowness of it - the ground is taken a little at a time, so no single step looks like the violation that *invasive* makes it sound.

invasive.oewn-01355168-s.label: negative

family.axis: pushing in where one is unwanted → offensive meddling in what is not one's business

invasive.oewn-01355168-s.tone: The same gradual advance, framed as spread into ground that is not its own, where *encroaching* keeps the emphasis on the edging forward.

trespassing.oewn-01355168-s.label: negative

family.axis: pushing in where one is unwanted → offensive meddling in what is not one's business

trespassing.oewn-01355168-s.tone: Puts the intrusion in terms of a line crossed without permission, naming the wrong outright where *encroaching* only lets it accumulate.

interfering.oewn-01355409-s.label: negative

family.axis: pushing in where one is unwanted → offensive meddling in what is not one's business

interfering.oewn-01355409-s.tone: The flattest of the meddling group - it faults the getting-in-the-way rather than heaping on the contempt that *meddlesome* carries.

meddlesome.oewn-01355409-s.label: negative

family.axis: pushing in where one is unwanted → offensive meddling in what is not one's business

meddlesome.oewn-01355409-s.tone: Makes the offensive prying a settled trait of the person, not the single act that *meddling* catches them at.

meddling.oewn-01355409-s.label: negative

family.axis: pushing in where one is unwanted → offensive meddling in what is not one's business

meddling.oewn-01355409-s.tone: Condemns the deed in progress, where *meddlesome* condemns the character behind it.

officious.oewn-01355409-s.label: negative

family.axis: pushing in where one is unwanted → offensive meddling in what is not one's business

officious.oewn-01355409-s.tone: Formal and cold beside the homely *busybodied*, delivering the same charge of offensive meddling as a verdict rather than a complaint.

busy.oewn-01355409-s.label: negative

family.axis: pushing in where one is unwanted → offensive meddling in what is not one's business

busy.oewn-01355409-s.tone: An everyday word carrying the whole meddling charge, so the disparagement lands quietly where *officious* announces itself.

busybodied.oewn-01355409-s.label: negative

family.axis: pushing in where one is unwanted → offensive meddling in what is not one's business

busybodied.oewn-01355409-s.tone: Turns the offender into a type, dismissing the whole person rather than the one act *meddling* points to.

infelicitous.oewn-01004300-a.label: negative

family.axis: regrettably unsuitable → graceless to the point of incompetence

infelicitous.oewn-01004300-a.tone: Formal and softened - it marks a thing as both misapplied and defective while keeping an apologetic surface, where *inept* simply condemns.

awkward.oewn-01004599-s.label: negative

family.axis: regrettably unsuitable → graceless to the point of incompetence

awkward.oewn-01004599-s.tone: Mild - the expression stumbles without collapsing, and no verdict is passed on the ability behind it, unlike *inept*.

clumsy.oewn-01004599-s.label: negative

family.axis: regrettably unsuitable → graceless to the point of incompetence

clumsy.oewn-01004599-s.tone: Heavier than *awkward* - the expression is not merely ungainly but handled with a thick hand.

cumbersome.oewn-01004599-s.label: negative

family.axis: regrettably unsuitable → graceless to the point of incompetence

cumbersome.oewn-01004599-s.tone: Faults the expression for weight and unwieldiness, landing on the shape of the thing where *clumsy* lands on the handling.

inapt.oewn-01004599-s.label: negative

family.axis: regrettably unsuitable → graceless to the point of incompetence

inapt.oewn-01004599-s.tone: The dry, measured option - it records an expression as not fitting, with none of *clumsy*'s picture of bungled handling.

inept.oewn-01004599-s.label: negative

family.axis: regrettably unsuitable → graceless to the point of incompetence

inept.oewn-01004599-s.tone: The hardest of these words - it shifts the fault from the phrasing to the ability behind it, so gracelessness reads as incompetence.

ill-chosen.oewn-01004599-s.label: negative

family.axis: regrettably unsuitable → graceless to the point of incompetence

ill-chosen.oewn-01004599-s.tone: Blames the selection rather than the person, faulting the words picked where *inept* faults whoever picked them.

unfortunate.oewn-01004966-s.label: negative

family.axis: regrettably unsuitable → graceless to the point of incompetence

unfortunate.oewn-01004966-s.tone: The gentlest wording available - it calls a thing unsuitable and regrettable at once, treating the fault as bad luck rather than bad work.

unfortunate.oewn-01053161-a.label: negative

family.axis: misfortune total enough to bring ruin or invite contempt → plain ill luck

unfortunate.oewn-01053161-a.tone: The mildest way to mark ill luck, registering that fortune went against someone with none of the ruin *calamitous* insists on.

ambitious.oewn-00104850-a.label: positive

family.axis: mild wish for advancement → ambition pressed past what it can carry

ambitious.oewn-00104850-a.tone: The plain name for the desire itself, favourable but only mildly, and carrying no fault until *overambitious* attaches one.

pushful.oewn-00105117-s.label: negative

family.axis: mild wish for advancement → ambition pressed past what it can carry

pushful.oewn-00105117-s.tone: States the aggression as a quality of the person and still counts the energy and initiative in, so it stings less than *pushy*.

pushy.oewn-00105117-s.label: negative

family.axis: mild wish for advancement → ambition pressed past what it can carry

pushy.oewn-00105117-s.tone: The complaint form of that same drive: the energy is conceded, the aggression is what the word is actually for.

aspirant.oewn-00105332-s.label: neutral

family.axis: mild wish for advancement → ambition pressed past what it can carry

aspirant.oewn-00105332-s.tone: Formal and cool — it registers the reaching for recognition or advancement without any verdict on it, where *aspiring* sounds warm.

aspiring.oewn-00105332-s.label: positive

family.axis: mild wish for advancement → ambition pressed past what it can carry

aspiring.oewn-00105332-s.tone: Treats the reaching as a credit to the person, though it promises nothing beyond the wanting and the effort themselves.

wishful.oewn-00105332-s.label: neutral

family.axis: mild wish for advancement → ambition pressed past what it can carry

wishful.oewn-00105332-s.tone: Puts its weight on the wanting rather than on any force behind it, making it the gentlest way to say what *pushy* says harshly.

compulsive.oewn-00105498-s.label: negative

family.axis: mild wish for advancement → ambition pressed past what it can carry

compulsive.oewn-00105498-s.tone: Frames the motivation as something that has hold of the person, so it lands closer to a diagnosis than to the compliment *determined* pays.

determined.oewn-00105498-s.label: positive

family.axis: mild wish for advancement → ambition pressed past what it can carry

determined.oewn-00105498-s.tone: The approving way to say it — the motivation reads as steadiness of will rather than as pressure, which is what separates it from *driven*.

driven.oewn-00105498-s.label: positive

family.axis: mild wish for advancement → ambition pressed past what it can carry

driven.oewn-00105498-s.tone: Keeps the admiration but not the comfort: the motivation is felt as something pushing from behind rather than chosen.

manque.oewn-00105624-s.label: negative

family.axis: mild wish for advancement → ambition pressed past what it can carry

manque.oewn-00105624-s.tone: Formal, and it files the ambition as one that came to nothing — the same verdict *would-be* delivers far more bluntly.

would-be.oewn-00105624-s.label: negative

family.axis: mild wish for advancement → ambition pressed past what it can carry

would-be.oewn-00105624-s.tone: Deflating in one stroke: it grants the ambition and withholds the achievement in the same breath.

overambitious.oewn-00105741-s.label: negative

family.axis: mild wish for advancement → ambition pressed past what it can carry

overambitious.oewn-00105741-s.tone: Turns the quantity of the ambition into the fault, condemning as excess exactly what *ambitious* merely reports.

unnecessary.oewn-01585523-a.label: negative

family.axis: flat report that something is not needed → reproach that nothing warranted it at all

unnecessary.oewn-01585523-a.tone: The family's plain verdict - it states the thing was not needed and leaves any reproach implied rather than spoken, where *gratuitous* speaks it.

unneeded.oewn-01585523-a.label: neutral

family.axis: flat report that something is not needed → reproach that nothing warranted it at all

unneeded.oewn-01585523-a.tone: Flatter than *unnecessary* - it reports an absence of need without the faint blame that clings to the other word.

excess.oewn-01585713-s.label: neutral

family.axis: flat report that something is not needed → reproach that nothing warranted it at all

excess.oewn-01585713-s.tone: Measures the overshoot rather than judging it: a quantity past the mark, not a fault.

extra.oewn-01585713-s.label: neutral

family.axis: flat report that something is not needed → reproach that nothing warranted it at all

extra.oewn-01585713-s.tone: The easiest word here to hear without complaint - what lies beyond the requirement can simply be available, where *superfluous* would call the same amount waste.

redundant.oewn-01585713-s.label: negative

family.axis: flat report that something is not needed → reproach that nothing warranted it at all

redundant.oewn-01585713-s.tone: Sharper than *excess* - the surplus is treated as serving no purpose, not merely as a quantity over the line.

spare.oewn-01585713-s.label: neutral

family.axis: flat report that something is not needed → reproach that nothing warranted it at all

spare.oewn-01585713-s.tone: Frames what is past the requirement as held in reserve, so it reads as usable rather than as clutter.

supererogatory.oewn-01585713-s.label: neutral

family.axis: flat report that something is not needed → reproach that nothing warranted it at all

supererogatory.oewn-01585713-s.tone: Formal and weighty, marking the amount as going beyond what was required at all, with a dryness *extra* does not have.

superfluous.oewn-01585713-s.label: negative

family.axis: flat report that something is not needed → reproach that nothing warranted it at all

superfluous.oewn-01585713-s.tone: Dismissive where *excess* stays quantitative: it says the thing could be stripped away and nothing would be lost.

supernumerary.oewn-01585713-s.label: neutral

family.axis: flat report that something is not needed → reproach that nothing warranted it at all

supernumerary.oewn-01585713-s.tone: Positional and countable - it sets something outside the number required without passing any verdict on it.

surplus.oewn-01585713-s.label: neutral

family.axis: flat report that something is not needed → reproach that nothing warranted it at all

surplus.oewn-01585713-s.tone: A ledger word: it registers the amount left over as a balance and carries no complaint about it.

gratuitous.oewn-01586457-s.label: negative

family.axis: flat report that something is not needed → reproach that nothing warranted it at all

gratuitous.oewn-01586457-s.tone: The harshest of these - not merely that the thing was not needed, but that nothing justified it at all.

needless.oewn-01586457-s.label: negative

family.axis: flat report that something is not needed → reproach that nothing warranted it at all

needless.oewn-01586457-s.tone: Sounds the note of waste - unwarranted, and the sting is that it happened anyway; softer in rebuke than *gratuitous*.

uncalled-for.oewn-01586457-s.label: negative

family.axis: flat report that something is not needed → reproach that nothing warranted it at all

uncalled-for.oewn-01586457-s.tone: A rebuke rather than an assessment: it says the thing overstepped, where *unnecessary* only says it was not required.

inessential.oewn-01586632-s.label: neutral

family.axis: flat report that something is not needed → reproach that nothing warranted it at all

inessential.oewn-01586632-s.tone: The gentlest here - it grants that the thing may well be wanted and withholds only the claim that it is strictly required.

untamed.oewn-02397788-a.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly untamed → untamed and threatening

untamed.oewn-02397788-a.tone: The same natural state as *wild*, but framed as a taming that never happened, so it points at what has not been done to the thing.

feral.oewn-02398088-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly untamed → untamed and threatening

feral.oewn-02398088-s.tone: Wildness with a threat inside it - the menace is carried by the word itself rather than read in, which is what *untamed* lacks.

ferine.oewn-02398088-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly untamed → untamed and threatening

ferine.oewn-02398088-s.tone: The formal counterpart to *feral*, holding the same menace in a stiffer register.

savage.oewn-02398088-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly untamed → untamed and threatening

savage.oewn-02398088-s.tone: The heaviest here - the menace lands as ferocity, where *feral* only marks the wildness as dangerous.

semi-wild.oewn-02398217-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly untamed → untamed and threatening

semi-wild.oewn-02398217-s.tone: Purely a measure of degree - it places something part-way along the scale and judges it not at all.

unbroken.oewn-02398287-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly untamed → untamed and threatening

unbroken.oewn-02398287-s.tone: Defined against service - neither subdued nor trained to any use, so the wildness is measured by what the thing has not been made to do.

undomesticated.oewn-02398401-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly untamed → untamed and threatening

undomesticated.oewn-02398401-s.tone: A flat negation and nothing more, the plainest term in the family, with none of the menace *feral* adds.

foolish.oewn-02580838-a.label: negative

family.axis: absurdity that draws open contempt → light, laughable foolishness

foolish.oewn-02580838-a.tone: The plain, unadorned charge that good sense or judgement is simply absent, with none of the mockery *ridiculous* invites.

absurd.oewn-02581199-s.label: negative

family.axis: absurdity that draws open contempt → light, laughable foolishness

absurd.oewn-02581199-s.tone: Puts the unreasonableness first and lets the derision follow as a verdict, where *laughable* starts from the laugh.

cockeyed.oewn-02581199-s.label: negative

family.axis: absurdity that draws open contempt → light, laughable foolishness

cockeyed.oewn-02581199-s.tone: Informal and offhand, treating the thing as skewed out of true and waving it away rather than arguing with it.

derisory.oewn-02581199-s.label: negative

family.axis: absurdity that draws open contempt → light, laughable foolishness

derisory.oewn-02581199-s.tone: Carries the scorn in its own body: the thing is not merely open to derision but fit for nothing else.

idiotic.oewn-02581199-s.label: negative

family.axis: absurdity that draws open contempt → light, laughable foolishness

idiotic.oewn-02581199-s.tone: Hits hardest of these, aiming the derision squarely at whoever produced the thing rather than at the thing itself.

laughable.oewn-02581199-s.label: negative

family.axis: absurdity that draws open contempt → light, laughable foolishness

laughable.oewn-02581199-s.tone: Puts the derision in the response rather than in the thing - what is named is the laugh it draws, so it dismisses by amusement where *preposterous* repudiates out loud.

ludicrous.oewn-02581199-s.label: negative

family.axis: absurdity that draws open contempt → light, laughable foolishness

ludicrous.oewn-02581199-s.tone: Theatrical, full-blown absurdity, grander than *laughable* and past the point where argument is possible.

nonsensical.oewn-02581199-s.label: negative

family.axis: absurdity that draws open contempt → light, laughable foolishness

nonsensical.oewn-02581199-s.tone: Locates the failure in the sense itself, so nothing coherent is left to answer, where *absurd* still concedes a shape to reject.

preposterous.oewn-02581199-s.label: negative

family.axis: absurdity that draws open contempt → light, laughable foolishness

preposterous.oewn-02581199-s.tone: Formal and indignant, repudiating the absurdity out loud rather than merely laughing at it as *laughable* does.

ridiculous.oewn-02581199-s.label: negative

family.axis: absurdity that draws open contempt → light, laughable foolishness

ridiculous.oewn-02581199-s.tone: Blunt and immediate, the derision arriving without the argument *absurd* implies.

mindless.oewn-02581841-s.label: negative

family.axis: absurdity that draws open contempt → light, laughable foolishness

mindless.oewn-02581841-s.tone: Nothing at all stands behind it, neither intelligence nor thought, a flatter and heavier charge than *foolish*'s bad judgement.

vacuous.oewn-02581841-s.label: negative

family.axis: absurdity that draws open contempt → light, laughable foolishness

vacuous.oewn-02581841-s.tone: Formal and colder than *mindless*, treating the absence of intelligence or thought as a settled quality of the thing.

vacant.oewn-02581841-s.label: negative

family.axis: absurdity that draws open contempt → light, laughable foolishness

vacant.oewn-02581841-s.tone: Names the emptiness as blankness rather than stupidity, the intelligence and thought simply not in evidence.

goofy.oewn-02582052-s.label: negative

family.axis: absurdity that draws open contempt → light, laughable foolishness

goofy.oewn-02582052-s.tone: Almost fond, taking the foolishness as entertainment rather than a fault, a long way from *idiotic*.

silly.oewn-02582052-s.label: negative

family.axis: absurdity that draws open contempt → light, laughable foolishness

silly.oewn-02582052-s.tone: The gentlest word here, foolish and ludicrous at a scale too small to be worth condemning.

wacky.oewn-02582052-s.label: negative

family.axis: absurdity that draws open contempt → light, laughable foolishness

wacky.oewn-02582052-s.tone: Foolishness with energy behind it, off-kilter and lively where *silly* is merely slight.

injured.oewn-01320916-a.label: neutral

family.axis: harm merely reported → damage shown in graphic bodily detail

injured.oewn-01320916-a.tone: The flat report that harm was done, holding back every picture of it that *mangled* insists on showing.

battle-scarred.oewn-01321194-s.label: positive

family.axis: harm merely reported → damage shown in graphic bodily detail

battle-scarred.oewn-01321194-s.tone: Here the marks stand as proof of what was come through, so the damage reads as standing earned rather than harm suffered.

black-and-blue.oewn-01321272-s.label: neutral

family.axis: harm merely reported → damage shown in graphic bodily detail

black-and-blue.oewn-01321272-s.tone: Names the bruise by its two colours, homely and concrete beside the graver *livid*.

livid.oewn-01321272-s.label: negative

family.axis: harm merely reported → damage shown in graphic bodily detail

livid.oewn-01321272-s.tone: The same pooled discoloration in a leaden, grim register that makes the skin sound like something has gone badly wrong beneath it, where *black-and-blue* keeps it almost domestic.

disjointed.oewn-01321452-s.label: neutral

family.axis: harm merely reported → damage shown in graphic bodily detail

disjointed.oewn-01321452-s.tone: Structural and bloodless: the joint has come apart, and the word says nothing at all about pain.

dislocated.oewn-01321452-s.label: neutral

family.axis: harm merely reported → damage shown in graphic bodily detail

dislocated.oewn-01321452-s.tone: The exact term for a joint driven out of place, diagnostic where *disjointed* sounds merely come-apart.

separated.oewn-01321452-s.label: neutral

family.axis: harm merely reported → damage shown in graphic bodily detail

separated.oewn-01321452-s.tone: The barest statement of the same parting at the joint — it neither winces nor diagnoses.

eviscerate.oewn-01321601-s.label: negative

family.axis: harm merely reported → damage shown in graphic bodily detail

eviscerate.oewn-01321601-s.tone: The most graphic member: the body opened and emptied, damage gone past anything that could still be called a wound.

hurt.oewn-01321683-s.label: neutral

family.axis: harm merely reported → damage shown in graphic bodily detail

hurt.oewn-01321683-s.tone: The softest word here for real physical injury - it carries the gloss's lean toward battle lightly, and shows nothing of the wound itself.

wounded.oewn-01321683-s.label: neutral

family.axis: harm merely reported → damage shown in graphic bodily detail

wounded.oewn-01321683-s.tone: Graver and more formal than *hurt* for the same injury, dignifying the damage and letting the battlefield sit close without shutting out other harm.

lacerate.oewn-01321879-s.label: negative

family.axis: harm merely reported → damage shown in graphic bodily detail

lacerate.oewn-01321879-s.tone: The clipped form for flesh left with jagged edges, cool in shape even though the picture it raises is not.

lacerated.oewn-01321879-s.label: negative

family.axis: harm merely reported → damage shown in graphic bodily detail

lacerated.oewn-01321879-s.tone: The ordinary participle for that same ragged tearing, felt rather than measured, where *lacerate* stays curt.

mangled.oewn-01321879-s.label: negative

family.axis: harm merely reported → damage shown in graphic bodily detail

mangled.oewn-01321879-s.tone: The most violent of these: the jagged edges read as wreckage, the thing ruined rather than merely cut.

torn.oewn-01321879-s.label: negative

family.axis: harm merely reported → damage shown in graphic bodily detail

torn.oewn-01321879-s.tone: The plainest word for a ragged injured edge — it names the tearing and stops, where *mangled* piles on ruin.

raw.oewn-01322003-s.label: negative

family.axis: harm merely reported → damage shown in graphic bodily detail

raw.oewn-01322003-s.tone: Reports pain rather than shape: the covering is gone and what lies under it is left exposed and stinging, unlike the jagged-edge words beside it.

sudden.oewn-01146764-a.label: neutral

family.axis: suddenness that is jarring, violent or severe → plain quickness of onset

sudden.oewn-01146764-a.tone: The plain member of the family, covering both arrival without warning and arrival in very little time, and passing no verdict on either.

abrupt.oewn-01147070-s.label: negative

family.axis: suddenness that is jarring, violent or severe → plain quickness of onset

abrupt.oewn-01147070-s.tone: Pushes *sudden* past what anyone was braced for, so the speed itself becomes the complaint.

choppy.oewn-01147235-s.label: negative

family.axis: suddenness that is jarring, violent or severe → plain quickness of onset

choppy.oewn-01147235-s.tone: Faults the transitions as uneven rather than violent — the thing never settles, but nothing in it snaps.

jerky.oewn-01147235-s.label: negative

family.axis: suddenness that is jarring, violent or severe → plain quickness of onset

jerky.oewn-01147235-s.tone: Harsher than *choppy* on the same broken transitions: the movement snatches, and the word makes it sound ungoverned.

emergent.oewn-01147340-s.label: neutral

family.axis: suddenness that is jarring, violent or severe → plain quickness of onset

emergent.oewn-01147340-s.tone: Flat and functional beside *explosive* — the unexpectedness registers only because it compels urgent action, not because it startles.

explosive.oewn-01147494-s.label: negative

family.axis: suddenness that is jarring, violent or severe → plain quickness of onset

explosive.oewn-01147494-s.tone: Puts noise into the suddenness, so where *abrupt* merely catches you unready this one goes off.

fulminant.oewn-01147587-s.label: negative

family.axis: suddenness that is jarring, violent or severe → plain quickness of onset

fulminant.oewn-01147587-s.tone: Grave rather than merely fast: severity is bolted to the speed, so the word reads as a warning.

sharp.oewn-01147715-s.label: neutral

family.axis: suddenness that is jarring, violent or severe → plain quickness of onset

sharp.oewn-01147715-s.tone: Measures how far the change went as well as how fast it came, which is the dimension *sudden* leaves out.

evil.oewn-01134543-a.label: negative

family.axis: wrongness merely stated → cruelty fit for hell

evil.oewn-01134543-a.tone: The bare verdict: it names the wrongness itself and says nothing of the manner, which is what *atrocious* and *fiendish* are for.

atrocious.oewn-01134954-s.label: negative

family.axis: wrongness merely stated → cruelty fit for hell

atrocious.oewn-01134954-s.tone: The shock sits inside the word, so the brutality is reported as something that appals rather than as something merely wrong.

flagitious.oewn-01134954-s.label: negative

family.axis: wrongness merely stated → cruelty fit for hell

flagitious.oewn-01134954-s.tone: Formal and bookish where *atrocious* is loud, delivering the same charge of brutality in a cold register.

grievous.oewn-01134954-s.label: negative

family.axis: wrongness merely stated → cruelty fit for hell

grievous.oewn-01134954-s.tone: The weightiest of these - the brutality is felt as damage done rather than as spectacle, where *atrocious* reaches for the outrage.

monstrous.oewn-01134954-s.label: negative

family.axis: wrongness merely stated → cruelty fit for hell

monstrous.oewn-01134954-s.tone: Puts the cruelty outside the human, judging the doer as a kind of creature rather than as someone behaving badly.

bad.oewn-01135303-s.label: negative

family.axis: wrongness merely stated → cruelty fit for hell

bad.oewn-01135303-s.tone: The plainest word in the set made to carry wickedness, and the flatness is its force — *monstrous* shouts where this one only states.

bad.oewn-01073039-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely past its freshness → rotted, foul and crawling

bad.oewn-01073039-s.tone: The blankest possible condemnation — no mold, no smell, no rot named, just the ruling that the food can no longer be eaten or used.

black.oewn-01135435-s.label: negative

family.axis: wrongness merely stated → cruelty fit for hell

black.oewn-01135435-s.tone: Absolute and unshaded: the wickedness is treated as total rather than as a streak, and no mitigation is offered.

black.oewn-01053787-s.label: negative

family.axis: misfortune total enough to bring ruin or invite contempt → plain ill luck

black.oewn-01053787-s.tone: Delivers the verdict in one flat syllable, calling an event doomed where *calamitous* spells out the wreckage.

dark.oewn-01135435-s.label: negative

family.axis: wrongness merely stated → cruelty fit for hell

dark.oewn-01135435-s.tone: Suggestive rather than accusing, placing the evil behind what is visible — in what a thing comes out of as much as in the thing itself.

sinister.oewn-01135435-s.label: negative

family.axis: wrongness merely stated → cruelty fit for hell

sinister.oewn-01135435-s.tone: Adds menace to the wickedness, so that what it names feels still in motion and threatening rather than simply condemned.

corruptive.oewn-01135866-s.label: negative

family.axis: wrongness merely stated → cruelty fit for hell

corruptive.oewn-01135866-s.tone: Clinical in shape: it names an ongoing capacity to spoil rather than passing sentence on a single act.

perversive.oewn-01135866-s.label: negative

family.axis: wrongness merely stated → cruelty fit for hell

perversive.oewn-01135866-s.tone: Harsher than *corruptive*, since what it names does not merely degrade a thing but bends it out of true.

pestiferous.oewn-01135866-s.label: negative

family.axis: wrongness merely stated → cruelty fit for hell

pestiferous.oewn-01135866-s.tone: Makes the influence contagious — something to be kept clear of, not just something to disapprove of.

demonic.oewn-01136015-s.label: negative

family.axis: wrongness merely stated → cruelty fit for hell

demonic.oewn-01136015-s.tone: Attributes the cruelty to a nature rather than a choice, as though it were the whole of what the thing is.

diabolic.oewn-01136015-s.label: negative

family.axis: wrongness merely stated → cruelty fit for hell

diabolic.oewn-01136015-s.tone: Puts design behind the cruelty: intelligence at work, not the blind brutality of *atrocious*.

diabolical.oewn-01136015-s.label: negative

family.axis: wrongness merely stated → cruelty fit for hell

diabolical.oewn-01136015-s.tone: The longer form of *diabolic*, and the extra syllable gives it room to sound theatrical rather than clinical.

fiendish.oewn-01136015-s.label: negative

family.axis: wrongness merely stated → cruelty fit for hell

fiendish.oewn-01136015-s.tone: The most gleeful of these: the cruelty is relished, ingenuity taking pleasure in itself.

unequal.oewn-00895672-a.label: negative

family.axis: neutral statement of non-equality → imbalance felt as a fault or unfairness

unequal.oewn-00895672-a.tone: Carries a fault inside the measurement - poorly balanced or matched, not merely different - where *nonequivalent* only records that the quantities fail to agree.

anisometric.oewn-00895928-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral statement of non-equality → imbalance felt as a fault or unfairness

anisometric.oewn-00895928-s.tone: Technical and cool: it states that parts are out of symmetry or dimensions come out unequal, and stops there without calling either a defect.

unsymmetrical.oewn-00895928-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral statement of non-equality → imbalance felt as a fault or unfairness

unsymmetrical.oewn-00895928-s.tone: The plain-spoken counterpart to *anisometric* for the same condition of parts or measurements, describing the lack of match rather than complaining of it.

mismatched.oewn-00896066-s.label: negative

family.axis: neutral statement of non-equality → imbalance felt as a fault or unfairness

mismatched.oewn-00896066-s.tone: Of a contest or the contestants in it, this puts the fault in the pairing itself - these two should never have been set against each other.

uneven.oewn-00896066-s.label: negative

family.axis: neutral statement of non-equality → imbalance felt as a fault or unfairness

uneven.oewn-00896066-s.tone: Softer than *mismatched* for the same unfair contest: it notes that the thing tilts one way without condemning the making of the match.

nonequivalent.oewn-00896269-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral statement of non-equality → imbalance felt as a fault or unfairness

nonequivalent.oewn-00896269-s.tone: A flat denial rather than a complaint - the two are not equal and not interchangeable in value, quantity or significance, and the gap between them goes unjudged.

odds-on.oewn-00896411-s.label: positive

family.axis: neutral statement of non-equality → imbalance felt as a fault or unfairness

odds-on.oewn-00896411-s.tone: The one member where the imbalance is good news: the chance of success runs better than even, so the tilt reads as advantage rather than defect.

unbalanced.oewn-00896532-s.label: negative

family.axis: neutral statement of non-equality → imbalance felt as a fault or unfairness

unbalanced.oewn-00896532-s.tone: Strictly the ledger sense - debits failing to answer credits - which lands as an error in the books rather than as a neutral difference.

unequalized.oewn-00896640-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral statement of non-equality → imbalance felt as a fault or unfairness

unequalized.oewn-00896640-s.tone: Points at what was not done rather than at the result: no levelling has been applied, where *unequal* passes judgement on the gap that remains.

unequalised.oewn-00896640-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral statement of non-equality → imbalance felt as a fault or unfairness

unequalised.oewn-00896640-s.tone: The British spelling of *unequalized* and just as unjudging - it says only that nothing was made equal.

stale.oewn-01072500-a.label: negative

family.axis: merely past its freshness → rotted, foul and crawling

stale.oewn-01072500-a.tone: The plainest word here for the whole slide out of freshness — taste gone, condition gone with age — without yet ruling the food inedible the way *bad* does.

addled.oewn-01072943-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely past its freshness → rotted, foul and crawling

addled.oewn-01072943-s.tone: A flat verdict on an egg: not merely aging but past eating, and far blunter about it than *stale*.

spoiled.oewn-01073039-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely past its freshness → rotted, foul and crawling

spoiled.oewn-01073039-s.tone: Frames the same loss — no longer edible or usable — as damage done to the food, a ruin rather than *bad*'s bare verdict.

spoilt.oewn-01073039-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely past its freshness → rotted, foul and crawling

spoilt.oewn-01073039-s.tone: British spelling of *spoiled*, identical in force and equally final about food past eating or using.

day-old.oewn-01073363-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely past its freshness → rotted, foul and crawling

day-old.oewn-01073363-s.tone: Purely a matter of the calendar — it dates the food and leaves the verdict unspoken, where *stale* delivers one.

flyblown.oewn-01073579-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely past its freshness → rotted, foul and crawling

flyblown.oewn-01073579-s.tone: Disgust made literal: the ruin is not merely named but shown, with the flies' eggs and larvae sitting on it.

maggoty.oewn-01073579-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely past its freshness → rotted, foul and crawling

maggoty.oewn-01073579-s.tone: Carries the same infestation as *flyblown*, eggs and larvae alike, but puts the crawling larvae in front of you, which makes it the harder of the two to hear.

moldy.oewn-01073758-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely past its freshness → rotted, foul and crawling

moldy.oewn-01073758-s.tone: A specific and repellent charge — the growth seen on the food or smelled off it — where *bad* offers only a ruling.

mouldy.oewn-01073758-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely past its freshness → rotted, foul and crawling

mouldy.oewn-01073758-s.tone: British spelling of *moldy*, just as exact about mold either seen or smelled.

musty.oewn-01073758-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely past its freshness → rotted, foul and crawling

musty.oewn-01073758-s.tone: The gentlest of the three words for this condition, charging the same mold on the food or smell of mold off it with none of *moldy*'s bluntness.

rancid.oewn-01073991-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely past its freshness → rotted, foul and crawling

rancid.oewn-01073991-s.tone: Fixes on fats and oils gone over and on the rank smell or taste that gives them away, a sensory accusation rather than *bad*'s bare ruling.

rotten.oewn-01074208-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely past its freshness → rotted, foul and crawling

rotten.oewn-01074208-s.tone: The word for full collapse — decay carried through to disintegration, and foulness with it.

corrupt.oewn-01074386-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely past its freshness → rotted, foul and crawling

corrupt.oewn-01074386-s.tone: Formal, almost delicate for what it names: rot or decay has only touched the thing, not finished it as in *rotten*.

abject.oewn-01053640-s.label: negative

family.axis: misfortune total enough to bring ruin or invite contempt → plain ill luck

abject.oewn-01053640-s.tone: Superlative and unsparing, pushing misfortune to its floor where *unfortunate* only notes that luck ran out.

calamitous.oewn-01053787-s.label: negative

family.axis: misfortune total enough to bring ruin or invite contempt → plain ill luck

calamitous.oewn-01053787-s.tone: Sizes the event by the wreckage it brings and says so at volume, where *black* passes the same sentence without raising its voice.

disastrous.oewn-01053787-s.label: negative

family.axis: misfortune total enough to bring ruin or invite contempt → plain ill luck

disastrous.oewn-01053787-s.tone: The plainest word for ruin at full scale, doing the work of *calamitous* without its air of grandeur.

fatal.oewn-01053787-s.label: negative

family.axis: misfortune total enough to bring ruin or invite contempt → plain ill luck

fatal.oewn-01053787-s.tone: Treats the ruin as finished business, the consequences ending things rather than merely wrecking them as *disastrous* allows.

fateful.oewn-01053787-s.label: negative

family.axis: misfortune total enough to bring ruin or invite contempt → plain ill luck

fateful.oewn-01053787-s.tone: Weights the ruin with inevitability, as though the outcome were settled before the event, a solemnity *disastrous* never claims.

dispossessed.oewn-01054302-s.label: negative

family.axis: misfortune total enough to bring ruin or invite contempt → plain ill luck

dispossessed.oewn-01054302-s.tone: Frames the condition as something stripped away, whether the security lost is literal shelter or inward footing, where *homeless* only reports the absence.

homeless.oewn-01054302-s.label: negative

family.axis: misfortune total enough to bring ruin or invite contempt → plain ill luck

homeless.oewn-01054302-s.tone: The flat naming term, covering the person without a roof and the one without spiritual anchorage alike, and carrying none of the grievance in *dispossessed*.

roofless.oewn-01054302-s.label: negative

family.axis: misfortune total enough to bring ruin or invite contempt → plain ill luck

roofless.oewn-01054302-s.tone: Keeps a bleak physical picture even when the exposure it names is inward, which makes it starker than *homeless*.

hapless.oewn-01054589-s.label: negative

family.axis: misfortune total enough to bring ruin or invite contempt → plain ill luck

hapless.oewn-01054589-s.tone: Almost fond pity for someone luck keeps failing, entirely free of the contempt in *pathetic*.

miserable.oewn-01054589-s.label: negative

family.axis: misfortune total enough to bring ruin or invite contempt → plain ill luck

miserable.oewn-01054589-s.tone: Wretchedness thick enough to be uncomfortable to look at, far heavier than the light sympathy of *hapless*.

misfortunate.oewn-01054589-s.label: negative

family.axis: misfortune total enough to bring ruin or invite contempt → plain ill luck

misfortunate.oewn-01054589-s.tone: The plainest of these, granting that the pity is deserved and stopping there, where *pathetic* adds scorn to it.

pathetic.oewn-01054589-s.label: negative

family.axis: misfortune total enough to bring ruin or invite contempt → plain ill luck

pathetic.oewn-01054589-s.tone: Names the effect on whoever sees it - the pity is reported as landing, where *piteous* describes the appeal being made.

piteous.oewn-01054589-s.label: negative

family.axis: misfortune total enough to bring ruin or invite contempt → plain ill luck

piteous.oewn-01054589-s.tone: Elevated and unmixed, the suffering moving whoever sees it rather than lowering the sufferer as *pathetic* does.

pitiable.oewn-01054589-s.label: negative

family.axis: misfortune total enough to bring ruin or invite contempt → plain ill luck

pitiable.oewn-01054589-s.tone: Sits on the hinge between deserving pity and inciting it, so it will serve for either where *piteous* leans on the asking.

energetic.oewn-00876911-a.label: positive

family.axis: energy simply present → energy that will not flag

energetic.oewn-00876911-a.tone: The plain term of the family, covering energy merely held as readily as energy spent or shown, and approving mildly without insisting.

physical.oewn-00877400-s.label: neutral

family.axis: energy simply present → energy that will not flag

physical.oewn-00877400-s.tone: Puts the energy in the body and stops there - a description of what the activity is, not a verdict on it as *lively* is.

alert.oewn-00877534-s.label: positive

family.axis: energy simply present → energy that will not flag

alert.oewn-00877534-s.tone: Hears the quickness as responsiveness rather than pure pace, the coolest and least showy way of saying it.

brisk.oewn-00877534-s.label: positive

family.axis: energy simply present → energy that will not flag

brisk.oewn-00877534-s.tone: Crisp and businesslike - the pace earns approval on its efficiency alone, with none of the buoyancy *merry* adds.

lively.oewn-00877534-s.label: positive

family.axis: energy simply present → energy that will not flag

lively.oewn-00877534-s.tone: Warmer than *brisk*, since the quickness comes with visible animation rather than a merely good rate.

merry.oewn-00877534-s.label: positive

family.axis: energy simply present → energy that will not flag

merry.oewn-00877534-s.tone: Makes speed sound light and unforced where *brisk* makes it sound efficient.

rattling.oewn-00877534-s.label: positive

family.axis: energy simply present → energy that will not flag

rattling.oewn-00877534-s.tone: An intensifier more than a description, pushing quickness toward headlong in a way *brisk* never does.

snappy.oewn-00877534-s.label: positive

family.axis: energy simply present → energy that will not flag

snappy.oewn-00877534-s.tone: Informal and clipped - quickness with an edge on it, sharper and less dignified than *brisk*.

spanking.oewn-00877534-s.label: positive

family.axis: energy simply present → energy that will not flag

spanking.oewn-00877534-s.tone: Showier than *brisk*, admiring the sheer unchecked vigor of the pace rather than its neatness.

zippy.oewn-00877534-s.label: positive

family.axis: energy simply present → energy that will not flag

zippy.oewn-00877534-s.tone: The most informal of these, light and almost playful, carrying none of the weight *driving* does.

canty.oewn-00877855-s.label: positive

family.axis: energy simply present → energy that will not flag

canty.oewn-00877855-s.tone: Takes both halves at once, the animation of *lively* with the crispness of *brisk*, and stays mild where *rattling* is emphatic.

driving.oewn-00877942-s.label: positive

family.axis: energy simply present → energy that will not flag

driving.oewn-00877942-s.tone: Vigor with push and direction behind it - force applied to something, not energy on display as in *lively*.

high-energy.oewn-00878089-s.label: neutral

family.axis: energy simply present → energy that will not flag

high-energy.oewn-00878089-s.tone: A measurement rather than a compliment, rating what a reaction yields and carrying none of the approval its neighbours do.

indefatigable.oewn-00878228-s.label: positive

family.axis: energy simply present → energy that will not flag

indefatigable.oewn-00878228-s.tone: Formal and the most admiring of the three, treating the unflagging vitality as a quality of character rather than a rate of output.

tireless.oewn-00878228-s.label: positive

family.axis: energy simply present → energy that will not flag

tireless.oewn-00878228-s.tone: Plainer than *indefatigable*, praising the sustained action itself without dressing it up.

unflagging.oewn-00878228-s.label: positive

family.axis: energy simply present → energy that will not flag

unflagging.oewn-00878228-s.tone: Praises what does not happen - the enthusiasm never dips - so it commends steadiness where *tireless* commends capacity.

discontented.oewn-00592317-a.label: negative

family.axis: worried unease → discontent turned openly against authority

discontented.oewn-00592317-a.tone: The plain state-word of the family, reaching over both settled dissatisfaction and the restless longing for something else, and passing verdict on neither.

discontent.oewn-00592317-a.label: negative

family.axis: worried unease → discontent turned openly against authority

discontent.oewn-00592317-a.tone: Covers the same ground as *discontented* - dissatisfaction or restless longing alike - but reads as a fixed condition where the longer form allows a passing mood.

disaffected.oewn-00592653-s.label: negative

family.axis: worried unease → discontent turned openly against authority

disaffected.oewn-00592653-s.tone: Loyalty withdrawn: the discontent is pointed at authority but goes no further than turning away, where *rebellious* has already moved against it.

ill-affected.oewn-00592653-s.label: negative

family.axis: worried unease → discontent turned openly against authority

ill-affected.oewn-00592653-s.tone: Puts the weight on the ill feeling itself rather than on the falling-away *disaffected* names, and stays stiffer and more formal in doing so.

malcontent.oewn-00592653-s.label: negative

family.axis: worried unease → discontent turned openly against authority

malcontent.oewn-00592653-s.tone: Faintly contemptuous - it makes standing against authority into a disposition the person carries, not a response they had.

rebellious.oewn-00592653-s.label: negative

family.axis: worried unease → discontent turned openly against authority

rebellious.oewn-00592653-s.tone: The hottest of the authority-facing senses - the discontent is aimed squarely at whoever is in charge, where *disaffected* keeps it turned inward.

disgruntled.oewn-00592856-s.label: negative

family.axis: worried unease → discontent turned openly against authority

disgruntled.oewn-00592856-s.tone: Belittling - the sulk in it makes the grievance look like a mood, so the complaint gets dismissed along with the complainer.

dissatisfied.oewn-00592856-s.label: negative

family.axis: worried unease → discontent turned openly against authority

dissatisfied.oewn-00592856-s.tone: Reports the same sulky state with a straighter face, letting the mood be inferred where *disgruntled* puts it on display.

restless.oewn-00592964-s.label: negative

family.axis: worried unease → discontent turned openly against authority

restless.oewn-00592964-s.tone: Unease that will not sit still - the worry is felt as agitation rather than as a grievance against anything in particular.

ungratified.oewn-00592964-s.label: neutral

family.axis: worried unease → discontent turned openly against authority

ungratified.oewn-00592964-s.tone: The most detached way of naming the worried unease, stating it as a condition and holding nothing against the person in it.

unsatisfied.oewn-00592964-s.label: neutral

family.axis: worried unease → discontent turned openly against authority

unsatisfied.oewn-00592964-s.tone: Flat and unemphatic beside *restless*, registering the same worry and unease without any of the movement.
